summary: This note describes Jive Records, an American record label that operated under the RCA Music Group. It was formed in 1981 by Zomba Records and was previously based in New York City. The label is noted for hip hop successes in the 1980s and teen pop and boy bands in the 1990s and early 2000s.
one_line: Jive Records was an American record label under RCA Music Group, formed in 1981 by Zomba Records, known for hip hop and teen pop.
key_facts: Jive Records was an American record label under the RCA Music Group.
Jive Records was formed in 1981 by Zomba Records.
Jive Records was formerly headquartered in New York City.
The label was best known for a string of successes with hip hop artists in the 1980s.
Jive Records was also known for teen pop and boy bands during the 1990s and early 2000s.
